proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureMechanics family: passive
proposed_widenings.justification: Extra Attack is a permanent passive modifier with no activation, no use count, and no reset cadence. The only existing ClassFeatureMechanics family is 'activation', which requires UseCountResource and RestResetCadence — neither applies here. A new 'passive' family (or equivalent name) is needed for features that permanently alter combat mechanics without a resource gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

proposed_widenings.name: ClassFeatureEffect: grant_extra_attack (scale_attack_count)
proposed_widenings.justification: The effect is granting an additional weapon attack within the Attack action (1 → 2 attacks). This maps to the v4 scale_attack_count atom, but no ClassFeatureEffect variant currently encodes this. GrantExtraActionEffect grants an extra full action (Action Surge semantics); Extra Attack grants an extra weapon attack within a single Attack action — these are mechanically distinct.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can attack twice instead of once whenever you take the Attack action on your turn.

notes: The unit's core mechanic is entirely passive and permanent — it changes how the Attack action works for this character without any resource. The activation family cannot represent it without fabricating a resource/reset structure that has no SRD basis. The fighter's Extra Attack (L5) requires the same widening. The v4 taxonomy already includes scale_attack_count; the gap is at the surface type level only.
